title: Elux Firerose 5000 Pineapple Peach Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Peach Mango from the Elux Firerose 5000 collection is a sumptuous combination of tropical and traditional fruits. The vibrant sweetness of pineapple provides a tropical burst, evoking sun-kissed beaches and balmy breezes. This is complemented by the rich, juicy flavour of mango, adding a depth of sweetness and a hint of exotic flair. The addition of peach brings a soft, mellow contrast to the mix, balancing the tropical intensity with its subtle, velvety sweetness. This delightful trio creates a well-rounded and satisfying vaping experience, ideal for those who love a rich, fruit-forward vape. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Berry Bang ensures a perfectly balanced vape that’s ideal for those who enjoy both intense flavour and satisfying yet discreet cloud production. The Nicotine Salt formulation provides a silky smoothness of the vape and is suitable for use in any MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping device. Discover the delicious world of Elux Firerose 5000 Nic Salt e-liquids. This captivating range is inspired by some of Elux’s most popular disposable vape flavours, offering the same intensity of flavour but with the versatility and convenience that comes from 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of vape devices. Experience all dozen delicious Elux Firerose flavours available at Vapestore.
